$comment: Where every package stands on the seven-state ladder in docs/LIFECYCLE.md, and what is missing below the state it claims. Graded by scripts/check-package-evidence.mjs, wired as `npm run check:package-evidence`. This is lifecycle evidence, not a portfolio grouping: A/B/C were temporary delivery cohorts and are not part of the package model. A state is derived from evidence, never declared. A shortfall below a declared state must be acknowledged here with a reason and an issue -- an unacknowledged one fails the gate, and an acknowledgement that outlives its reason fails it too. The `gaps` list is a countdown, not a baseline: it is meant to shrink, and the gate refuses to let it go stale.

stagedBy.run: LOCAL fixture run — reproduce with `npm run stage:advisor` after checkout. It builds `packages/advisor`, then runs `node packages/advisor/dist/cli.js` against a temporary assessment with unresolved pre-work (exit 1, `state: violated`), the otherwise equivalent cleared control (exit 0, `state: satisfied`), and an unknown readiness observation (exit 2, `state: indeterminate`). The script finishes `Advisor fixture evidence: unresolved pre-work violated, the cleared control satisfied, and unknown readiness stayed indeterminate.`
stagedBy.defect: The temporary assessment leaves a first-wave baseline pre-work item unresolved. Advisor's compiled CLI produces its own violated state and exit 1 rather than allowing execution readiness through an uncleared prerequisite.
stagedBy.control: In the same fixture run, the otherwise equivalent assessment clears the baseline and conflict pre-work and exits 0 satisfied; an unknown readiness observation exits 2 indeterminate rather than becoming a pass.

stagedBy.run: LOCAL, not a CI run — after `npm ci && npm run build`, `node packages/controller/dist/cli.js docs/contracts/package-lifecycle.json . --scope @vespeneventures` printed `Package governance: PASS` and exited 0. The injected red ran the same dist CLI with `packages/locksmith` as root; it printed `Package governance: FAIL`, one packages-dir-missing foundation finding, 16 catalog-package-missing lifecycle findings, and exited 1. 2026-08-22.
stagedBy.defect: A consumer pointing the governance CLI at a package directory instead of its repository root is a real catalog defect. The built controller gate discovered no packages directory and named every lifecycle package the incomplete catalog omitted; the gate itself produced exit 1.
stagedBy.control: The same compiled CLI, lifecycle contract, and scope against this repository root stayed GREEN in the same session: 18 packages, zero foundation findings, zero lifecycle findings, and exit 0.

stagedBy.run: LOCAL fixture run, not a CI run — after building `packages/architect`, `node scripts/stage-architect.mjs` ran the compiled CLI. The topology red exited 1 violated and its control exited 0 satisfied; the exception red exited 1 violated, its control exited 0 satisfied, and the no-observation case exited 2 indeterminate. The script finished `Architect fixture evidence: topology and exception judgments discriminated, and absent evidence stayed indeterminate.` 2026-08-23.
stagedBy.defect: The topology fixture omitted the authority for its product responsibility, and the exception fixture observed a material crossing opposite the declared interface direction. The compiled architect CLI produced its own violated judgments and exit 1 for both defects.
stagedBy.control: In the same fixture run, the complete authority mapping and direction-matching crossing each stayed satisfied with exit 0. An empty observation set stayed indeterminate with exit 2 instead of becoming a false zero exception rate.

stagedBy.run: LOCAL, not a CI run — after `npm ci && npm run build`, run `node packages/inspector/dist/bin.js --inputs <red-input> --checks secret-scan`; the injected observation printed `secret-detected (src/a.ts): example-scanner rule generic-api-key` and `Overall: VIOLATED (exit 1)`. With the otherwise identical control containing zero hits, the same dist CLI printed `secret-scan | satisfied | 5 evaluated` and `Overall: SATISFIED (exit 0)`. 2026-08-22.
stagedBy.defect: A scanner reporting a credential-shaped hit at a source path is the real secret-scan violation this gate consumes. The compiled inspector entry point rendered its own violated report and exit 1, with no mocked return or forced process status.
stagedBy.control: The same scanner observation shape with five evaluated units and no hits stayed GREEN in the same local session, proving the dist CLI distinguishes a reported hit from a clean scan.

stagedBy.run: LOCAL, not a CI run — after `npm ci && npm run build`, run `node packages/builder/dist/ci/bin.js deployment-health --inputs <red-input>` with one healthy and one unhealthy surface. It printed `Overall: UNHEALTHY (exit 1)` with `healthy 1, degraded 0, unhealthy 1, unknown 0`. The control with the healthy surface only printed `Overall: HEALTHY (exit 0)`. 2026-08-22.
stagedBy.defect: An unhealthy deployment observation is a real input a consuming plane's deployment-health gate can receive. Builder's compiled dist CLI judged it unhealthy and supplied its normal exit 1 rather than a mock or forced exit status.
stagedBy.control: The otherwise same one-surface control with status healthy stayed GREEN in the same local session: builder printed HEALTHY, one healthy observation, and exit 0.

stagedBy.run: LOCAL, not a CI run — reproduce after `npm ci && npm run build`: run `node packages/locksmith/dist/infisical/cli.js catalog --catalog governance/locksmith-catalog.json` (printed the two value-free registry credential entries and exited 0). For the injected red, run the same dist CLI against a version-1 catalog containing GH_PACKAGES_TOKEN twice; it printed `Secret catalog must be value-free version 1 metadata with unique keys.` and exited 2. 2026-08-22.
stagedBy.defect: A duplicate credential name is a real value-free catalogue defect a consuming plane can produce. The built locksmith parser, not a mocked return or forced exit code, rejected the duplicate-key catalogue and printed its own uniqueness failure.
stagedBy.control: The repository-owned governance/locksmith-catalog.json stayed GREEN in the same local staging session: the built dist CLI printed its two declared, value-free workflow credential classes and exited 0. The control differs only by having unique keys.

stagedBy.run: LOCAL, not a CI run — reproduce after `npm ci && npm run build`: run `node packages/integrator/dist/cli.js package.json governance/foundry-supersession-map.json --block` (printed `Evaluated 2 declared supersessions. No conflicting pairs installed.` and exited 0). For the injected red, run the same dist CLI with a manifest whose dependencies contain @vespeneventures/auth and @vespeneventures/bouncer; it printed `1 conflicting pair installed together` and exited 1. 2026-08-22.
stagedBy.defect: A manifest pinning both the retained auth donor and its published bouncer replacement is the real duplicate-install condition this supersession gate judges. The built CLI found the pair in dependencies and produced its normal blocking exit 1, not a mocked result or forced exit code.
stagedBy.control: The repository's root package.json stayed GREEN in the same local staging session against governance/foundry-supersession-map.json: both declared relationships were evaluated and no conflicting pair was installed, so the built CLI exited 0 in --block mode.

stagedBy.run: LOCAL, not a CI run — after `npm ci && npm run build`, run `node packages/observer/dist/bin.js --input <red-input>` with observer installed in repo-a and the same package declared absent there. stagedBy.defect: An installed package simultaneously declared absent is the real coverage contradiction observer exists to surface. Its compiled CLI found the contradiction and emitted its normal violated exit 1, not a mocked verdict or forced process code.
stagedBy.control: The otherwise identical installed inventory without a declared absence stayed GREEN in the same local session: observer classified the package installed with no contradiction and exited 0.

stagedBy.run: LOCAL, not a CI run — no Actions URL exists for it. Reproduce: build designer, copy packages/designer/styles/tokens.css, set --color-ink-primary to oklch(0.9702 0 0) (identical to --color-surface-base), then `node packages/designer/dist/tokens/contrast-cli.js <that file>`. 2026-08-22.
